claims.text: The workflow combines a pretrained symmetry-aware generator, a separate calibrated ensemble selector, model relaxation and genuine first-principles validation. It is not a newly trained transformer architecture.
claims.title: An integrated research prototype

claims.text: Quality retrieved 41.2 near-stable records per 50 queries on average, versus 29.4 for Full. Every one of the five paired differences favoured Quality. These are dependent splits of one historical dataset.
claims.title: The full policy found fewer historical hits

claims.text: Full covered 42.2 chemical systems on average versus Quality's 32.8, while retrieving fewer historical near-stable records. Coverage is not discovery yield.
claims.title: Broader chemistry coverage had a retrieval cost

claims.text: Full endpoint nominal-90% interval coverage averaged 88.88%, ranging from 84.84% to 92.10% by split. This does not guarantee calibration for arbitrary OOD chemistry or generated crystals.
claims.title: Uncertainty ranked error but coverage varied

claims.text: Full conservative slots found 140/175 historical hits, optimistic slots 7/75. The roles selected different candidates and were not randomized; the breakdown does not isolate causality.
claims.title: The role breakdown is descriptive

claims.text: MgO yielded 7/8 versus 0/8 valid cells and TiO2 6/8 versus 1/8 for nontrivial groups versus P1. Both arms use the same symmetry-aware architecture; this is not an architecture-training ablation.
claims.title: Conditioning improved primary exact-cell validity

claims.text: Each control has one selected unique structure per arm. MgO uses the supplemented pool, TiO2 the primary pool. The CHGNet energy differences do not establish a distribution, a DFT symmetry advantage or a causal architecture benefit.
claims.title: Two selected model-energy comparisons

claims.text: Six proposals are absent from the two pinned historical composition indexes. Global composition novelty and absence from generator pretraining remain unproven.
claims.title: Historical composition absence is scoped

claims.text: None of 48 new-formula transformer draws met the frozen exact-cell gate. Twelve larger-cell ratio/geometry matches remain excluded; rejection is not proof of physical instability.
claims.title: The exact-cell gate was the bottleneck

claims.text: Four symmetry selections, four prepared prototypes and three references converged under CHGNet. Ten launches were new and one calculation was reused identically; prototypes did not replace the empty transformer shortlist.
claims.title: Eleven selected model calculations converged

claims.text: Saved MP geometry coverage is 15/23 MgO and 34/44 TiO2 entries. Both P1 outputs are unmatched to this saved subset only.
claims.title: Unmatched is not globally novel

claims.text: The accepted generated MgO matches the known source reference. Its -0.005533 meV/atom energy difference is numerically unresolved; recovery is not discovery.
claims.title: Fresh DFT recovered known MgO

claims.text: The 900-second perturbation stopped without accepted terminal SCF convergence. Source-reference coverage is 2/161 Ca-Mg-O and 1/57 Mg-O; no full competing-phase hull is established.
claims.title: Perturbation and competition remain incomplete

claims.text: Model convergence, catalog absence, process exit zero and a known-phase DFT recovery cannot establish a newly discovered stable material, phonon stability or synthesis feasibility.
claims.title: No new stable material was established

notes: Source hashes establish file identity, not scientific acceptance.
Predictive uncertainty, model energy, fresh DFT energy, novelty and stability are distinct concepts.
